text:
Maya: Hey team — starting bring-up for orca-2b INT4 quantized variant. Need a quick plan for QA traffic split across hosted / dedicated / private and a clear fallback if quality regression appears. TL;DR: propose small traffic bridge (5% hosted + 5% dedicated) for 2h, 0% private initially. Thoughts?

Kevin: I like small bridge. We should run eval suites A (dialog) + B (summarization) and track Rouge / EM deltas. Latency SLO: p50 < 150ms, p95 < 400ms.

Sam: From past quant runs (raven) INT4 gave ~0.6-1.2% quality drop. Let's set explicit thresholds: rouge_delta_pct < 1.5 and hallucination_rate < 2.0 before we promote.

Olivia: Ops checklist: name the model variant orca-2b-int4-q1, create rollout entry in Console, ensure keys (KMS) and audit logging for private deployments. Also confirm dedicated pool sizing.

Maya: Fallback plan: if any eval breaches thresholds or user-visible errors spike, auto-fallback to orca-2b-int8 or orca-2b-fp16. Policy: automatic hold for 10m + rollback if issues persist.

Kevin: Quick rollout config snippet for Console (paste into rollout config):
```
traffic_split:
  hosted: 0.05
  dedicated: 0.05
  private: 0.0
canary_duration: 2h
metrics:
  eval_suite: ["dialog-A", "summ-B"]
  quality_thresholds:
    rouge_delta_pct: 1.5
    hallucination_pct: 2.0
rollback: auto_on_threshold_breach
```

Sam: Also add synthetic probing traffic (50 rps) to warm KV cache and expose any perf regressions early. Include a small load test at 200 concurrent users pre-promote.

ci-bot: CI: unit tests ✅, quant-check ✅, perf-smoke ✅. Artifact: gcr.io/redwood/orca-2b-int4-q1@sha256:abcd1234

Olivia: Observability additions: create alerts for p95 latency > 400ms, error_rate > 0.5% during canary window, and a regression alert if rouge delta > 1.5% on eval pipeline. Also add token-cost estimate per 1M tokens to rollout ticket.

Maya: Cost estimate draft sent to thread (spreadsheet link). For private customers we should keep private pool at 0% until we validate quality for hosted/dedicated.

Kevin: Dedicated pool note: provision mixed-precision fallback nodes (INT8 / FP16) labeled pool=orca-int4-fallback so autoscale can route on regression.

Sam: Experiment plan: progressive quant sweep (q1 symmetric, q2 GPTQ-lite) and log evals for both. Capture sample prompts that cause highest deltas.

Maya: Agreed. I'll create ML ticket ML-3456 with steps + attach eval harness. Scheduling: propose 30-min kickoff window tomorrow 10:00 PST to start canary. @Olivia @Kevin @Sam please confirm availability.

Olivia: Confirmed.

Kevin: Confirmed.

Sam: Confirmed.

Maya: Great — I'll post final rollout config to #eng-ml-docs and update ML-3456. If anything interesting shows up during the 2h canary we'll either auto-rollback or snapshot logs and escalate. :thumbsup:
